name: whisper-alone
description: Voice-to-text macOS app — double-tap Command to transcribe with Whisper

scripts.start: npm run prepare:dev-permissions && npm run build && electron ./dist/main/main.js
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.install:local: npm run dist:dir && npm run sign:local && bash ./scripts/install-local-app.sh

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: WhisperAlone needs microphone access to record audio for transcription.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: WhisperAlone needs automation access to paste transcribed text.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: WhisperAlone needs Accessibility permission to detect the dictation hotkey and paste transcribed text.
